race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery
race.verdict: The 2 interesting ones PRIDE'S QUEEN and Hemustbeanangel are drawn on the outside, which isn't ideal, but they are still expected to come to the fore. Ready preference is for the Botti filly given her latest second can be upgraded quite a lot. Rocsane may keep on for a place. PRIDE'S QUEEN HEMUSTBEANANGEL (IRE) ROCSANE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Pride's Queen (3/1), Lilywhite Hart (9/2), Lushill (11/2), Hemustbeanangel (11/2), Beechwood Glory (13/2), Postremo (10/1), Seathegulls (12/1), Rocsane (12/1), Alpha Legend (20/1), Havana Grey Star (25/1), Percy Shaw (33/1), True Charm (50/1)
